name: Curler Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a bronze curling wand with dizzy spiral eyes, a dotted grin, a hanging loop and a grey spiral heating rod
entry: It curls the fur of any Pokémon that sits still. Its spiral eyes make onlookers dizzy.
how: Use a Curling Wand on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Draining Kiss in this form.
